title: "setupmjr"
toc: true
---

`setupmjr` is a cross-platform setup utility for shell, R, Git, repository, HPC and coding-agent environments.

## Start here

Install the CLI using a supported package manager, release installer or source build. See [Installation](install.qmd) for the canonical commands.

For authoritative top-level syntax, run:

```bash
setupmjr --help
```

The `agent` command also has detailed option help:

```bash
setupmjr agent --help
```

## Command groups

| Command | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `setupmjr hpc` | Configure Linux HPC shell, Git, scratch, Apptainer, SLURM and R setup. |
| `setupmjr shell` | Configure Bash or Zsh startup, executable paths and login integration. |
| `setupmjr bash` | Shorthand for `setupmjr shell bash`. |
| `setupmjr r` | Configure `radian`, `lintr` and the optional project-local `switch_r` helper. |
| `setupmjr git` | Configure Git identity and GitHub authentication. |
| `setupmjr repo` | Scaffold repository files, devcontainers and released workflow examples. |
| `setupmjr install` | Install or refresh external tools whose setup glue is owned by setupmjr. |
| `setupmjr agent` | Configure coding-agent credentials, providers and opt-in subagents. |

External tools keep ownership of their own behaviour. In particular, use `repos` directly after `setupmjr install --repos`, and use `pj` directly after `setupmjr install --pj`.
